resolved_findings.evidence: Preparation baseline SHA carried into activate_release; cooperating thread/process writers serialize; writer receives exact expected_old bytes and checks before final commit. Stale baseline, earlier and late races, and two competing API threads covered.
Helper shortcut removed. API exact pointer acknowledgment includes schema/release/manifest SHA; same epoch/generation with corrupted fields rejected without overwrite.

preserved_guards: All thirteen admitted scientific originals, source/snapshot pins and version guards
All snapshot bytes/chunks/line ranges, including CRLF, preserved
Partial/crashed or tampered immutable release refused, never silently rebuilt
Earlier releases remain in the versioned tree
Legacy safe_files calls remain compatible; byte backup of exact prior state verified independently
limitations: Review covers only pinned candidate bytes and disposable tests; production installation and activation remain root responsibilities after byte backups and source CAS.

Activation lock is cooperative: updated activation API users share it. External raw-file writers must not bypass the protocol. No new guard service, daemon, MCP restart, provider call or ACOM-library change was performed.
This is scientific memory packaging and retrieval validation, not independent validation of every scientific statement or mathematical proof.
